_about: Verdicts on look-alike owner names that scripts/owner_consistency.py lists as near groups (one name is the other plus a word). different = two companies, never joined; step3 = a rename, a merged or sold company, or a name that needs research, handled in plan step 3 with refs (docs/plans/2026-10-20_owner-consistency.md). Keyed 'shorter || longer' as the report prints them.

adnoc || adnoc gas.note: ADNOC is the parent; ADNOC Gas plc is its listed gas subsidiary.

alliance || alliance canada.note: Alliance LP, Alliance USA and Alliance Canada are informal names for the two Alliance Pipeline partnerships, one in Canada and one in the US. Which one holds each segment needs a ref.

cheniere energy || cheniere energy partn.note: Cheniere Energy Partners LP is a separate listed partnership controlled by Cheniere Energy Inc.

dcp midstream.note: DCP Midstream LLC and DCP Midstream LP are two companies in the Phillips 66 2025 annual report. Which one owns each pipeline is a per-row question.

dominion energy || dominion energy trans.note: Dominion Energy Transmission Inc was sold to Berkshire Hathaway Energy in 2020 and renamed Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage Inc.

dominion transmission.note: Dominion Transmission Inc is the older name of Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage Inc, sold to Berkshire Hathaway Energy in 2020.

dominion transmission || dominion energy.note: Dominion Transmission Inc is the older name of the same company, now Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage Inc.

egyptian natural gas || egyptian natural.note: Egyptian Natural Gas Co (GASCO) is a subsidiary of Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Co (EGAS).

energy transfer || energy transfer partn.note: Energy Transfer Partners merged into Energy Transfer LP in 2018 and no longer exists.

energy || energy partners.note: The Energy Cooperative and JP Energy Partners are unrelated.

equinor || equinor energy.note: Equinor ASA is the parent; Equinor Energy AS is the Norwegian subsidiary that holds licence stakes.

equitrans || equitrans midstream.note: Equitrans LP is the pipeline subsidiary of Equitrans Midstream Corp. EQT bought Equitrans Midstream in 2024, so that name is a step 3 check.

genesis || genesis energy.note: Genesis on the Kupe row is Genesis Energy Ltd of New Zealand, not Genesis Energy LP of the US. The full name goes on the row in step 3 with a ref.

iroquois pipeline || iroquois pipeline o.note: Iroquois Pipeline Operating Co is the operating company, separate from the owner.

kuwait petroleum || kuwait petroleum int.note: Kuwait Petroleum International is a subsidiary of Kuwait Petroleum Corp.

nextera energy || nextera energy resourc.note: NextEra Energy Resources LLC is a subsidiary of NextEra Energy Inc.

north huajin chemical industries || nort.note: The group corporation is the parent of the Co Ltd.

phillips 66 || phillips 66 partners.note: Phillips 66 Partners LP merged into Phillips 66 in 2022 and no longer exists.

phillips 66 || phillips 66 pipeline.note: Phillips 66 Pipeline LLC is a subsidiary of Phillips 66.

sabine crossing || sabine crossing pipel.note: Federal Register notices name Sabine Crossing, LLC in April 2024 and Sabine Crossing Pipeline, LLC in April 2026 for the same Stage 5 project, so this looks like a rename. P7798 and P5509 may also be one pipeline.

sempra || sempra energy.note: Sempra Energy renamed itself Sempra in 2023. Both spellings are on the ownership team's list.

shell || shell pipeline.note: Shell Pipeline Co LP is a subsidiary of Shell PLC.

siemens || siemens energy.note: Siemens Energy AG was spun off from Siemens AG in 2020.

southern || southern energy.note: Southern Co is a US utility; Southern Energy SA is an Argentine LNG company.

spectra energy || spectra energy partner.note: Enbridge bought Spectra Energy Corp in 2017 and Spectra Energy Partners in 2018; neither exists now.

sunoco || sunoco pipeline.note: Sunoco Pipeline LP is an Energy Transfer subsidiary; Sunoco LP is a separate listed partnership.

wbi energy || wbi energy transmission.note: WBI Energy Transmission Inc is a subsidiary of WBI Energy.

williams || williams partners.note: Williams Partners LP merged into Williams in 2018 and no longer exists.
